verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a self-contained sandbox that mirrors production, with separate sandbox accounts and credentials, so developers can test API calls 'without touching any live PayPal accounts'. The Agent Toolkit's tools call the same REST APIs (orders, payments, disputes), which places the core agent-facing tooling inside that sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit docs that the hosted MCP server, Store Sync cart reverse-API, and Agent Ready (Braintree ACP/UCP) flows can be exercised in sandbox mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use for agentic flows.
